description: A React functional component that displays per-user usage metrics including tables and charts. It fetches data from an API, manages pagination, and visualizes user request distribution with a stacked bar chart.

methods.name: fetchPerUserData
methods.description: Fetches per-user analytics data from the API and updates component state.

methods.name: handleNextPage
methods.description: Handles pagination to navigate to the next page of results.

methods.name: handlePrevPage
methods.description: Handles pagination to navigate to the previous page of results.
